label: Diagram 4.3
caption: Diagram 4.3 Layout restrictions on small class D-s3, d2 plastic rooflights, TP(b) rooflights and lighting diffusers
description: The drawing is a ceiling plan, titled at the bottom in a green bar as "Diagram 4.3 Layout restrictions on small class D-s3, d2 plastic rooflights, TP(b) rooflights and lighting diffusers", with the note "See Table 4.2" in the top left corner. At the centre is a large solid green rounded rectangle, the zone. To its left, partly outside, sits a vertical rectangle rooflight carrying a diagonal line marked "dimension x"; a horizontal green arrow labelled "x min." runs from it to a second vertical rectangle rooflight set within the green zone, also marked "dimension x". A further horizontal green arrow labelled "x min./" leads from this second rectangle to a circular rooflight on the right. On the right are three circular rooflights, the middle one overlapped by a smaller green circle, with vertical and horizontal green arrows labelled "y min." and a downward line labelled "dimension y". Dashed outlines trace a rounded rectangle around the left rooflights and dashed circles around the right ones. Below, the legend shows a green square for "Materials within this zone – at plane of ceiling – should comply with Table 4.1" and a rectangle-over-circle symbol for "Rooflights".

notes: The description says the left rooflight is "partly outside" the zone, but the drawing shows it sitting entirely outside the green rounded-rectangle zone, with none of it inside the green fill.
The description calls the first "x min." arrow "horizontal", but the drawing shows it as a diagonal line slanting upward from the bottom of the left rooflight to the top of the second rooflight.
